purpose: Query-density scaling with a fixed number of Zero client processes and an increasing number of distinct materialized queries. This does not imply Hasura-style batching or multiplexing.

start_spread_diagnostic.note: Expected to increase when many queries are materialized over a fixed set of Zero clients.
